archived_author_code.scope: Archived code inspection only; absent processed inputs were not reconstructed and the original pipeline was not rerun.
archived_author_code.selection_description: Each control and treatment count >=10; FDR<=0.10; same-coordinate guide matches across replicates; at least two same-direction guides per gene; NDUFS6 removed; separate expression lookup >=1.

claim_permissions.scope: Numerical agreement does not validate the rejected guide-significance claim. Published catalogue labels and selected source probabilities retain their explicitly stated limits; source values are unchanged.

S7_S8_linkage.interpretation: Matching uses exact source gene, genomic coordinate, control count, treatment count and LFC. Numeric rounding compatibility is an observation, not proof of the export mechanism. S7 is selected-guide evidence and cannot repair the complete S8 denominator.

candidate_S7_selected_subset_evidence.scope: Full-precision source values for the published selected-guide subset only. Matches establish source alignment; they are not an independent experiment, reconstructed genome-wide significance, or complete evidence of nonsignificant/opposing guides.

interpretive_rule: A stored 0 is an observed encoded value; this audit does not interpret it as a validated FDR or p-value.
review_disposition: Post-review V2 retains published Table S1 decisions and independently reports stored-value diagnostics. The binary guide fields cannot establish the original guide-significance threshold.

saved_import_pipeline.finding: The saved Table S8 import query explicitly coerces all four p/FDR fields to Int64.Type. The Table S7 query coerces p.low only. This identifies a concrete type-conversion stage consistent with the stored binary cells; it does not establish author intent or recover original values.
